title: Child stratum parent-1 mapping mislabels provenance classes and diverges from Python
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c:333-337. Spec 09 section 14.6 defines stratum as source QUALITY with mandatory protocol-stratum binding (Direct NTS must use 3, Roughtime 2, mismatches rejected); parent-1 makes hop-2 nodes downstream of NTS/GNSS roots advertise labels they never earned. Python StratumTracker adopts wire stratum verbatim (MESH_DERIVED constant) - interop diverges across generations. Zero in-tree callers yet, latent. Fix: constant CONSERVATIVE(1) for all non-BR parents aligned with Python, or spec amendment.
close_reason: update_from_parent now sets constant LICHEN_TIME_STRATUM_CONSERVATIVE(1) for every valid non-root parent, mirroring Python Stratum.MESH_DERIVED==1 (time_sync.py:300 = link.h:496 numeric-identical). Guard rejects NO_SYNC parent and >4 range (-EINVAL preserved). Old parent-1 path (3->2 Roughtime claim, 4->3 NTS claim) mislabeled provenance against spec 09 s14.6 protocol/stratum binding; clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra clean with stub zephyr headers.
